title: MOVEMENT DISORDER, CONGENITAL NONPROGRESSIVE, WITH ATAXIA AND EYE MOVEMENT ABNORMALITIES

intro.text: This entry describes a congenital, nonprogressive movement disorder characterized by ataxia and eye movement abnormalities (CONMAE); the specific reports and causal gene are not recalled here with sufficient confidence to state them.

checks.claim: CONMAE is a congenital, nonprogressive movement disorder.
checks.evidence_quote: we implicate ESRRG in the etiology of a non-progressive congenital movement disorder with ataxia.
checks.explanation: The abstract describes the disorder as congenital and non-progressive.

checks.evidence_quote: All individuals have motor developmental delay, muscular hypotonia, and eye movement disorders, as well as congenital ataxia or gait imbalance.
checks.explanation: Ataxia is a core feature, and it appears in the disorder's name.

checks.claim: CONMAE is characterized by eye movement abnormalities.
checks.evidence_quote: All individuals have motor developmental delay, muscular hypotonia, and eye movement disorders, as well as congenital ataxia or gait imbalance.
checks.explanation: The abstract reports eye movement disorders in all affected individuals.

paragraphs.text: Congenital nonprogressive movement disorder with ataxia and eye movement abnormalities (CONMAE) is a neurologic disorder with onset in infancy or early childhood. It is characterized by ataxia and abnormal eye movements, and the course is nonprogressive.

checks.evidence_quote: we implicate ESRRG in the etiology of a non-progressive congenital movement disorder with ataxia.
checks.explanation: A congenital movement disorder with ataxia is a neurologic disorder, so this follows directly.

checks.claim: CONMAE begins in infancy or early childhood.
checks.evidence_quote: we implicate ESRRG in the etiology of a non-progressive congenital movement disorder with ataxia.
checks.explanation: The abstract calls the disorder congenital and mentions motor developmental delay, but it gives no onset age. 'Infancy or early childhood' is an inference that goes beyond the abstract.

checks.evidence_quote: All individuals have motor developmental delay, muscular hypotonia, and eye movement disorders, as well as congenital ataxia or gait imbalance.
checks.explanation: Ataxia is reported as a feature of the disorder.

checks.claim: CONMAE is characterized by abnormal eye movements.
checks.evidence_quote: All individuals have motor developmental delay, muscular hypotonia, and eye movement disorders, as well as congenital ataxia or gait imbalance.
checks.explanation: Eye movement disorders are reported in all individuals.

checks.claim: The course of CONMAE is nonprogressive.
checks.evidence_quote: we implicate ESRRG in the etiology of a non-progressive congenital movement disorder with ataxia.
checks.explanation: The abstract states the disorder is non-progressive.
